page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Main text in one column, with curly-brace labels (MI CI, M JVI, TI CI) set in the left margin beside the braces. The braces are part of the text block and the labels are printed in the margin, so each label is a note beside its brace group.

main_text.l: Me illic, vel illuc: Mici fermái, Fermáimici due giórni: biduum illic mansi. Mici fè andáre, Fémmici andáre: curauit vt illuc irem.
Mihi illic: Mi ci diéde, Diédemici móglie: illic mihi vxorem dedit.
Me vobis: Io mi ui raccomándo, Raccomándomiui: Me vobis commendo.
Mihi vos: Vóimiui raccomandáfte, Raccomandáftemiui: Mihi vos commendastis.
Me illic, vel illuc: Miui vefti, vefstimmiui: illic me vestiuit. Miui meno, Menómmiui: me illuc duxit.
Mihi illic: Miui comprò, comprómmiui, vn giardíno: hortum mihi illic emit.

page.notes: The labels MI CI, M JVI and TI CI are printed in the left margin beside the braces; the last label TI CI stands at the foot right. Ligatures and the long s are normalised to plain s. Some italic and roman word boundaries in the verse-like Italian/Latin pairs are approximate.
